cancelConfirmBody: You will finish cancelling on Tebex. Your plan stays active until {date}.
cancelConfirmBodyNoDate: You will finish cancelling on Tebex. Your plan stays active until the end of the current period.
degraded: Billing data is temporarily unavailable. What you see may be incomplete. Try again shortly.
descChoose: Choose a plan. Tebex handles secure payment; nothing is stored on this page.
descManage: Manage your plan and status. Tebex handles payment and subscription changes.
freeDesc: Every feature works on the free plan, with no time limit. Premium adds priority, covered below.
giftCtaHint: Pay for another streamer's premium. They need an ItsBagelBot account, and they get notified the moment your payment lands.
giftModalBody: Pay for another streamer's month of Premium. They need an ItsBagelBot account, and get a notification (and an email, if there is one on file) the moment your payment lands.
giftNeedRecipient: Enter a Twitch username to send a gift.
giftNoteLink: Gift notes can't contain links or web addresses. Please remove it and try again.
giftSentBody: Their month of Premium is activating now, and they have been notified.
giftSentNamedPost: has been told. Their month of Premium is activating now.
prizePending: Your prize is pending verification. You still keep the full award.
prizeEmailMissing: No contact email is on file; your prize does not require a claim.
prizeBillingPending: Billing protection is still being verified. No date is shown until it is confirmed.
manageTiny: Both redirect to Tebex-hosted subscription management, where cancellation is one click.
messagePlaceholder: Say something nice. It rides along in their gift email.
oath: No card on file, cancel in one click, checkout runs through Tebex's secure hosted page.
paymentReceivedBody: Thank you. This page updates on its own, usually within a minute.
paymentSlowBody: Tebex confirmed the payment, but activation is taking longer than usual. It can take a few minutes. Refresh this page later, and contact support if it still shows Free.
perMonth: per month, taxes added at checkout
premiumActivatedBody: Your support keeps ItsBagelBot running. The priority lane and every premium perk are unlocked now.
premiumDesc: Keeps the servers warm and bumps you to the front of the queue when chat gets loud.
premiumFeat2: Your messages jump to the front of the line
premiumFeat5: Early access to beta features, AutoMod first
premiumFine: Monthly renews automatically until cancelled. One month is a single charge, no renewal.
staffGrantHint: Premium granted by ItsBagelBot{until}. Nothing to pay and nothing will be charged while the grant is active.
tebexHint: {state}{until}. Use Tebex-hosted subscription management to review payments or change the subscription.
toastCheckoutCancelled: Checkout cancelled. No charge was made.
vipHint: VIP is permanent. It never expires and there is nothing to pay.
prizeUnavailable: Prize history is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
paymentFailed: Your last renewal payment failed. Update your payment method on Tebex to keep Premium going.
receiptsEmailed: Tebex emails a receipt to your purchase email after every payment.
